_comment: Downloadable standalone Wine builds for Uncork's Wine Manager (the 'Wine Builds' tab, Heroic-style). These are whole Wine trees (bin/lib/share) fetched on demand into engine/wine-builds/<id>. Distinct from compat/profiles.json 'Engines' (matched Wine+backend the game pickers use): a Wine Build is a raw runtime you can trial when a game/launcher misbehaves (e.g. the EA app was tried on wine-staging-11.13). Data-driven: add a build here, it appears in the manager without an app rebuild. Installed via scripts/ensure-wine-build.sh.
_schema: builds.<id>: { name, version, channel(stable|staging|devel|crossover|gptk), url, size_mb, dxmt(bool), summary, notes }

wine-stable-11.0.name: Wine Stable
wine-stable-11.0.summary: Gcenx Wine Stable 11.0 with DXMT, Uncork's default engine base.
wine-stable-11.0.notes: The bundled default. Most Steam/Epic/GOG games run here.

wine-staging-11.13.name: Wine Staging
wine-staging-11.13.summary: Gcenx Wine Staging 11.13 with DXMT, extra experimental patches over stable.
wine-staging-11.13.notes: Try when a game regresses on stable. (For the EA app: runs, but does not clear EA's macOS gRPC-BGS wall, see wine-fixes/diagnostics/grpc-localhost.)

wine-devel-11.13.name: Wine Devel
wine-devel-11.13.summary: Gcenx Wine Development 11.13 with DXMT, newest upstream, least stable.
wine-devel-11.13.notes: Bleeding-edge upstream Wine. Use to check whether a fresh upstream fix helps a title.

wine-staging-11.10.name: Wine Staging 11.10
wine-staging-11.10.summary: Gcenx Wine Staging 11.10 with DXMT, an older staging build.
wine-staging-11.10.notes: Older version. Roll back to it when a game regressed after a newer Wine.

wine-staging-11.9.name: Wine Staging 11.9
wine-staging-11.9.summary: Gcenx Wine Staging 11.9 with DXMT, an older staging build.
wine-staging-11.9.notes: Older version, kept for rolling back a title that broke on a newer Wine.

wine-staging-11.8.name: Wine Staging 11.8
wine-staging-11.8.summary: Gcenx Wine Staging 11.8 with DXMT, an older staging build.
wine-staging-11.8.notes: Older version, kept for rolling back a title that broke on a newer Wine.

wine-staging-11.7.name: Wine Staging 11.7
wine-staging-11.7.summary: Gcenx Wine Staging 11.7 with DXMT, an older staging build.
wine-staging-11.7.notes: Older version, kept for rolling back a title that broke on a newer Wine.

wine-staging-11.6.name: Wine Staging 11.6
wine-staging-11.6.summary: Gcenx Wine Staging 11.6 with DXMT, the oldest staging build Gcenx still hosts.
wine-staging-11.6.notes: Oldest available. Gcenx prunes older majors (10.x and earlier are no longer hosted).

_dxmt_note: Gcenx macOS_Wine_builds bundle DXMT (D3D11 to Metal) since Wine 10; the d3d11/dxgi builtins are the DXMT ones.
_install_dir: engine/wine-builds/<id> (writable per-user data dir at runtime)
